description: Consult this tool before recommending attractions, restaurants, cafes, temples, museums, viewpoints, parks, hotels, transport or practical stops in Shanghai, Jiangsu or Zhejiang. Matches English, Hebrew and Chinese names, descriptions and addresses. Preserve the returned location.lat/lon, links.map and links.page_he/page_en in your response.

category.description: Specific category key (e.g. temple, museum, historical, viewpoint, park, nature, food, asian, western, vegetarian, coffee, teahouse, bar, homestay, hostel, hotel, transport, shop, toilet, info).

query.description: Search text in English, Hebrew or Chinese (e.g. 'Yu Garden', '豫园', 'xiaolongbao', 'גן יו').

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers when lat/lon are provided (default 2, max 50).

name: search_places
title: Search Places
